engine.rules.WARN_MS_01: Two push workouts in one day: your shoulders need at least 3-4 hours of rest between sessions.
engine.rules.WARN_MS_02: Front Lever and OAPU on the same day put critical load on the tendons. Keep them at least 4 hours apart.
engine.rules.WARN_MS_03: Pull + Full Body on the same day: your back will work twice. Put the skill in the morning and Full Body in the evening.
engine.rules.WARN_MS_04: Muscle-Up + another workout on the same day: MU taxes the CNS. Do it first, and the other workouts 4+ hours later.
engine.rules.WARN_01: Two push days in a row: your shoulders don’t recover.
engine.rules.WARN_02: Two pull days in a row: your tendons need 48 hours.
engine.rules.WARN_03: MU taxes the CNS: the next skill should come at least two days later.
engine.rules.WARN_06: 5 days in a row: add a rest day.
engine.rules.WARN_07: OAPU above 3X: risk of chronic tendinitis.
engine.rules.WARN_09: Your tendons are still recovering from OAPU.
engine.rules.WARN_14: 3 upper-body days in a row: add rest or legs.
engine.rules.WARN_15: Saturday isn’t the default day. Make sure it fits your routine.
engine.rules.WARN_05: Handstand needs a minimum of 3X/week to improve.

tutorial.home.title: Now, your schedule
tutorial.home.text: Tell me when it suits you to train, and I’ll build a week that fits your life.
tutorial.persona.coach: Select everything that applies, not just one. That way I’ll know when you really have time.
tutorial.days.title: Which days?
tutorial.days.subtitle: And when in the day
tutorial.days.coach: You don’t have to plan the whole week. Select just tomorrow if you don’t know yet, and you can always change it. Tapping Morning / Noon / Evening sets the part of the day. Tapping again opens an exact time for that day only.
